create_map_dataset: create a MapDataset that applies a transformation function over elements in a dataset, skipping None results
build_dataset_from_list: build a DatasetFromList from a Python list with optional copy and serialization for efficient multi-process data loading
convert_to_iterable_dataset: convert a map-style dataset to an iterable-style dataset with sharding support across PyTorch DataLoader workers
group_by_aspect_ratio: group dataset elements into batches by aspect ratio to reduce padding overhead during training
test_map_dataset: test MapDataset with a map function that filters out invalid samples by returning None
